williamsonSecondDerivation.agreementRate: 92.2% (exact+partial) of unique situs matches also agree on independently-sourced owner name -- strong evidence the situs join finds the same real-world property, not a coincidental address collision

williamsonFanOutMechanism.sampledCase: R022482, situs 'RONALD REAGAN BLVD, LIBERTY HILL, TX 78642' (no house number -- an arterial/tract address), fans out to 64 distinct numeric accounts under related commercial LLCs (SANTA RITA COMMERCIAL LLC, SRFV DEVELOPMENT LLC, SANTA RITA KC LLC, SANTA RITA INVESTMENTS LTD)
williamsonFanOutMechanism.conclusion: ambiguity is a real-world artifact of large commercial tracts subdivided into many accounts sharing one imprecise situs string, not a data-quality defect this crosswalk can resolve. Refuse, do not guess.

williamsonPrefixStripDisproof.example: R000009 (situs 200 RIO VISTA DR, GEORGETOWN, TX 78626; owner BREM, ALEC W & CAITLIN; market 401306) matches numeric account 62578 (same situs, same owner normalized, market 394000, improvement 313000, living 2022). A prefix-strip of R000009 would produce '9', which is a different, unrelated account. Concrete proof the heuristic is wrong, not merely risky.

bastropParentLinkAtScale.regexUsed: LOCA?TED ON R([0-9]+), leading zeros stripped before matching against cad_property.prop_id

bastropOrphanPopulationSplit.conclusion: the two orphan populations named in the gap ledger (8712 living>0, 6158 $0) are NOT one mechanism. living>0 orphans are predominantly mobile homes on someone else's land (parent-resolvable). $0-improvement orphans carry ZERO parent-land references -- a structurally different population.

bastropZeroImprovementCharacterization.sampledOtherBucket: random 15-row sample of the 'other' bucket: business personal property (10 of 15, legal_description prefix 'BUS PERS PROPERTY - LOCATED @ <address>' -- a business location string, not a parcel), mineral/royalty fractional interests with varied legal_description formats not caught by the strict regex (BAZARSKY/BILLIE ANN/BEHRENS-style entries), one utility distribution system (CenterPoint Energy), one cell site (AT&T Mobility). None are land parcels.
bastropZeroImprovementCharacterization.conclusion: the 5119 'other' rows are overwhelmingly non-parcel personal-property tax accounts (business equipment, mineral/royalty interests, utility infrastructure, leased equipment) that structurally never have surface geometry -- this is not-applicable, not unaccounted. The 1037 real-acreage rows (D1 ag-use code observed) ARE real land with land_value>0 that simply fails to join txgio_parcel -- a separate, genuine open question (possible txgio coverage gap on rural/ag parcels), not covered by either the parent-link or the non-spatial-account mechanism.
